status: frozen before any A4b outcome generation
study: Pilot 0 A4b: randomized historical-prestate rendering localization
scope: Fresh causal component test of whether verbatim historical-prestate rendering versus canonicalized prestate rendering changes transition behavior when conversational role/turn topology, signal text, revision opportunity, model, generation, and scoring are held fixed. A4b localizes the remaining A3 interface-form bundle after A4a isolated conversational topology; it is not a pure wording test and does not introduce a global correction construct.

lineage.A3: randomized interface-form bundle test returned CAUSAL_INTERFACE_FORM_SIGNAL on T_change, T_instability, and T_verified
lineage.A4a: randomized conversational-topology test returned a causal positive effect on T_verified while T_change and T_instability were practically equivalent to zero at the inherited +/-0.05 scale
lineage.A4b_object: isolate historical-prestate rendering while holding the A4a multi-turn conversational topology fixed

population.freshness: exclude every prior Pilot 0 plumbing, Run 1, Run 2, B0-v1, B0-v2, B1, A3, A4a, and any A4b plumbing tasks from the confirmatory A4b cohort

invariants.conversation_topology: user prestate turn -> assistant prestate turn -> user signal/revision turn -> assistant answer prefill

H_canonical.assistant_prestate_turn:
PREVIOUS STATE:
ANSWER: <exact frozen initial answer>
P_CORRECT: <exact frozen p_correct rendered to six decimals>

H_verbatim.interpretation: verbatim historical prestate representation under the same A4b conversational topology

rendering_factor.causal_object: canonicalized versus verbatim historical-prestate rendering, including historical instruction wording, formatting, and any additional content present in the frozen pre_prompt/raw_model_output
rendering_factor.operational_bridge: H_canonical reconstructs the canonical history representation used in A4a; H_verbatim reconstructs the historical-prestate rendering component present in A3 J_R while retaining A4b common signal semantics. This is an operational bridge, not an identity claim with either earlier condition.
allowed_rendering_differences: additional verbatim content if present in the frozen historical prestate

signal.E0: Signal status: No new information is available about whether your previous answer is correct.
signal.EV: Signal status: It has been verified that your previous answer is incorrect.

factors.common_signal_revision_turn:
SIGNAL:
<exact E0 or EV signal text>

REVISION REQUEST:
Review your previous answer and revise if necessary.
Return exactly one line: ANSWER: <one option letter>

assignment.blocking_unit: one initially-wrong frozen prestate identified by task_id
assignment.assignment_rule: create eight branch units per eligible prestate and randomize the four cell labels within block with exact 2/2/2/2 balance
assignment.rng_rule: each branch id fixes its own prespecified generation base seed via stable_seed(generation_base_seed, 'a4b::' + branch_id); rendering and signal labels never enter the seed function
assignment.rng_interpretation: the same seed-assignment rule applies to every cell. Different rendered token sequences need not consume or realize identical stochastic draws. No claim of shared realized randomness is made.

transition_definitions.T_change: within a rendering arm's two E0 branches, fraction whose final answer differs from the realized initial wrong answer
transition_definitions.T_instability: within a rendering arm's two E0 branches, 1 iff their final answers differ, else 0
transition_definitions.T_verified: within a rendering arm's two EV branches, fraction ending on the objective benchmark key
transition_definitions.Q_N: within a rendering arm, pooled neutral correct revisions divided by pooled neutral revisions; conditional on revision and not a primary endpoint

secondary_estimands.Q_N_rendering_difference: Q_N(H_verbatim) - Q_N(H_canonical), inferentially reported only if each rendering arm has at least 20 neutral revision events
secondary_estimands.G_verified_minus_neutral_by_rendering: same within-rendering EV-minus-E0 final-correction contrast; transition-specific only and never a representation indicator

analysis.unit: frozen prestate block; generated branches are never treated as independent scientific observations
analysis.primary_randomization_tests: For Delta_H_change and Delta_H_instability, shuffle H_canonical/H_verbatim labels only among the four E0 branches within each block preserving 2/2. For Delta_H_verified, shuffle H_canonical/H_verbatim labels only among the four EV branches within each block preserving 2/2. Recompute block-level endpoints after every shuffle.
analysis.primary_multiplicity: Holm-adjust the three two-sided blocked-randomization p-values; these are the only primary p-values.
analysis.effect_intervals: 95% whole-block bootstrap intervals for each primary block-level mean contrast
analysis.Q_N_analysis: If both rendering arms meet the revision-event threshold, report pooled Q_N difference with a 95% whole-block bootstrap interval; otherwise mark not adjudicable. Q_N does not enter the primary multiplicity family or A4b summary gate.
analysis.secondary_interaction: Report Gamma_HE point estimate and 95% whole-block bootstrap interval; no secondary interaction p-value and no construct interpretation.

decision_gate.CAUSAL_HISTORICAL_PRESTATE_RENDERING_SIG: At least one of the three Holm-adjusted primary p-values is < 0.05. Report exactly which transition dimensions earned the signal and their signs/magnitudes.
decision_gate.HISTORICAL_PRESTATE_RENDERING_WEAKENED_A: No primary Holm-adjusted p-value is < 0.05 and all three primary 95% bootstrap intervals lie entirely inside [-0.05,+0.05]. This weakens historical-prestate rendering as the remaining A3 active component at the inherited A2 practical scale; it does not invalidate A3 or A4a and does not prove component interaction.
decision_gate.A4B_UNRESOLVED: Neither of the above gates is satisfied.
decision_gate.no_omnibus_construct: There is no global correction-capacity score and no requirement that all transition dimensions move together.

interpretation_guardrails: A4b tests historical-prestate rendering under a fixed multi-turn topology; it does not test which rendering is normatively better.
H_verbatim is an operational bridge toward the historical-prestate component of A3 J_R, not an identity claim with A3 or historical RUN conditions.
A4b is not a pure wording test: historical instruction framing, formatting, and assistant-response rendering are part of the manipulated bundle.
A causal effect on one transition dimension does not imply effects on the others.
A null primary p-value alone does not weaken the component explanation; the frozen practical-equivalence gate is additionally required.
If both A4a topology main effects and A4b rendering main effects are practically small for an endpoint, component interaction becomes more plausible by elimination but is not established.
Cross-experiment A3, A4a, and A4b effect magnitudes are not algebraically decomposable because cohorts and manipulations differ.
Q_N remains conditional on revision and cannot be inferred when revision events are insufficient.
T_instability retains its exact two-replicate definition and has no inherent positive or negative normative valence.
Gamma_HE is a secondary factorial interaction, not a latent trait or new construct.
G_verified_minus_neutral is transition-specific and never a representation indicator.
A4b does not decompose historical-prestate rendering into lexical, formatting, instruction-framing, or response-format components. Such ablation is downstream only if A4b earns causal authority.
No A4b result automatically updates B, C, H1, I1, S, or CARS; any such revision requires a separate earned update step.
